C1531.title: Coinbase Issues Warning on Quantum Computing Threat
C1531.summary: In June 2026, the Coinbase Quantum Advisory Council published an analysis of Bitcoin's post-quantum migration and estimated that approximately seven million Bitcoin were potentially quantum-vulnerable, including funds held at addresses with exposed public keys and reused addresses. The article discusses theft risks if future quantum computers break elliptic-curve signatures and urges the ecosystem to plan address migration and rules for abandoned coins in advance.
